[[File:Fratricide.png|thumb|250px|Ulic Qel-Droma killed his brother, Cay.]]
{{Quote|Cay, my brother! What have I done?|Ulic Qel-Droma, upon murdering his brother|<ref name="TOTJ5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Parricide''' was the act of [[Death/Legends|murdering]] one's own [[Parent/Legends|father]] (patricide), mother (matricide), sibling (fratricide) or a close relative. In the [[galactic community]], parricide was regarded as a particularly outrageous crime. Even the [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], who saw murder as a viable method of dealing with intractable issues, considered parricide a very serious offense to their social order.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> However, several cases of parricide had a major impact on galactic history. Most notably, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself had become [[House Palpatine/Legends|his family's]] patriarch at age seventeen, before even reaching the [[age of responsibility]], upon murdering his [[Cosinga Palpatine|father]], [[Palpatine's mother|mother]], and [[Palpatine's siblings|siblings]].<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Decades later, the heads of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] were all replaced after a mass parricide known as the [[Cleansing of Serenno]].<ref name="AOTE2">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]]</ref>
